title: SystemPricingPlan
description: A pricing plan defined by a shared mobility system, describing costs and billing rules for vehicle use. v2.1 adds the full FARE_POLICY tag group fields from V1 ONDC TRV10. All monetary fields that carry arbitrary-precision decimal strings in V1 are typed as string.

planId.description: Unique identifier for the pricing plan

isTaxable.description: Whether tax is applied to this pricing plan

perMinuteChargingRate.description: Charge per minute of vehicle use

perKmChargingRate.description: Charge per kilometre of vehicle use

perTripStartingFee.description: Flat fee charged at the start of each trip

tags.description: V1-compatible tag groups preserved verbatim for lossless V2→V1 round-trip.

cancellationCharges.description: Fixed cancellation fee. Maps to V1 FARE_POLICY.CANCELLATION_CHARGES.

driverMinExtraFee.description: Minimum additional fee the driver can charge. Maps to V1 FARE_POLICY.DRIVER_MIN_EXTRA_FEE.

driverMaxExtraFee.description: Maximum additional fee the driver can charge. Maps to V1 FARE_POLICY.DRIVER_MAX_EXTRA_FEE.

petCharges.description: Surcharge for travelling with a pet. Maps to V1 FARE_POLICY.PET_CHARGES.

nightShiftStartTime.description: Start of night shift window (HH:MM:SS). Maps to V1 FARE_POLICY.NIGHT_SHIFT_START_TIME.

nightShiftEndTime.description: End of night shift window (HH:MM:SS). Maps to V1 FARE_POLICY.NIGHT_SHIFT_END_TIME.

nightShiftStartTimeInSeconds.description: Night shift start as seconds from midnight. Maps to V1 FARE_POLICY.NIGHT_SHIFT_START_TIME_IN_SECONDS.

nightShiftEndTimeInSeconds.description: Night shift end as seconds from midnight. Maps to V1 FARE_POLICY.NIGHT_SHIFT_END_TIME_IN_SECONDS.

congestionChargePercentage.description: Surcharge percentage during congestion periods. Maps to V1 FARE_POLICY.CONGESTION_CHARGE_PERCENTAGE.

customerExtraFeeTaxMultiplier.description: Tax multiplier on customer extra fee. Maps to V1 FARE_POLICY.CUSTOMER_EXTRA_FEE_TAX_MULTIPLIER.

baseDistance.description: Distance (metres) covered by base fare. Maps to V1 FARE_POLICY.BASE_DISTANCE.

baseFare.description: Fixed fare at trip start covering base distance. Maps to V1 FARE_POLICY.BASE_FARE.

deadKilometerFare.description: Fare per km for driver travel to pickup. Maps to V1 FARE_POLICY.DEAD_KILOMETER_FARE.

extraPerKmFare.description: Per-km rate beyond base distance. Maps to V1 FARE_POLICY.EXTRA_PER_KM_FARE.

extraPerKmStepFare3000Above.description: Per-km step rate above 3000m. Maps to V1 FARE_POLICY.EXTRA_PER_KM_STEP_FARE_3000_Above.

waitingChargePerMin.description: Charge per minute waiting beyond free window. Maps to V1 FARE_POLICY.WAITING_CHARGE_PER_MIN.

waitingChargeRatePerMin.description: Rounded waiting rate per minute for display. Maps to V1 FARE_POLICY.WAITING_CHARGE_RATE_PER_MIN.

freeWaitingTimeInMinutes.description: Minutes of free waiting before charges begin. Maps to V1 FARE_POLICY.FREE_WAITING_TIME_IN_MINUTES.

nightShiftCharge.description: Flat fee or multiplier during night shift. Maps to V1 FARE_POLICY.NIGHT_SHIFT_CHARGE.

nightShiftChargePercentage.description: Percentage surcharge during night shift. Maps to V1 FARE_POLICY.NIGHT_SHIFT_CHARGE_PERCENTAGE.

driverExtraFeeBoundsStepMinFee0Above.description: Min driver extra fee bound for distance >= 0. Maps to V1 FARE_POLICY.DRIVER_EXTRA_FEE_BOUNDS_STEP_MIN_FEE_0_Above.

driverExtraFeeBoundsStepMaxFee0Above.description: Max driver extra fee bound for distance >= 0. Maps to V1 FARE_POLICY.DRIVER_EXTRA_FEE_BOUNDS_STEP_MAX_FEE_0_Above.

rideFareDiscountApplicableTaxExclusive.description: Discountable fare portion excluding tax. Maps to V1 FARE_POLICY.RIDE_FARE_DISCOUNT_APPLICABLE_TAX_EXCLUSIVE.

rideFareDiscountApplicableTax.description: Tax on the discountable fare portion. Maps to V1 FARE_POLICY.RIDE_FARE_DISCOUNT_APPLICABLE_TAX.

rideFareNonDiscountApplicableTaxExclusiv.description: Non-discountable fare portion excluding tax. Maps to V1 FARE_POLICY.RIDE_FARE_NON_DISCOUNT_APPLICABLE_TAX_EXCLUSIVE.

rideFareNonDiscountApplicableTax.description: Tax on the non-discountable fare portion. Maps to V1 FARE_POLICY.RIDE_FARE_NON_DISCOUNT_APPLICABLE_TAX.

tollFareTaxExclusive.description: Toll charge excluding tax. Maps to V1 FARE_POLICY.TOLL_FARE_TAX_EXCLUSIVE.

tollFareTax.description: Tax on toll charge. Maps to V1 FARE_POLICY.TOLL_FARE_TAX.

cancellationFeeTaxExclusive.description: Cancellation fee excluding tax. Maps to V1 FARE_POLICY.CANCELLATION_FEE_TAX_EXCLUSIVE.

cancellationTax.description: Tax on cancellation fee. Maps to V1 FARE_POLICY.CANCELLATION_TAX.

parkingChargeTaxExclusive.description: Parking charge excluding tax. Maps to V1 FARE_POLICY.PARKING_CHARGE_TAX_EXCLUSIVE.

parkingChargeTax.description: Tax on parking charge. Maps to V1 FARE_POLICY.PARKING_CHARGE_TAX.
